factories.name: newSearchConversationsStep
factories.description: List one page of up to 30 conversations of the brand, filtered by Re:amaze view, requester email, tags, channel, and latest customer message time, with the next page number.

inputSchema.description: SearchConversationsInput selects one page of the brand's conversations with Re:amaze's list filters, GET /conversations. Different filters narrow each other.

channel.description: Channel keeps conversations in the channel with this slug, Re:amaze's category, such as support.

customerMessageSince.description: CustomerMessageSince keeps conversations whose latest customer message is at or after this RFC 3339 instant, Re:amaze's start_date. Blank applies no lower bound.

customerMessageUntil.description: CustomerMessageUntil keeps conversations whose latest customer message is at or before this RFC 3339 instant, Re:amaze's end_date. Blank applies no upper bound.

filter.description: Filter is Re:amaze's view: blank for every unarchived conversation, open, unassigned, archived, or all.

page.description: Page is 1 to MaxSearchPage; zero reads the first page.

requesterEmail.description: RequesterEmail keeps conversations relevant to the user with this email, Re:amaze's for parameter; for a customer, the conversations that customer can see, which can include conversations the customer was copied on. Blank keeps every user.

sort.description: Sort orders the page: blank by creation, updated by the latest customer update, or changed by any update or status change.

tags.description: Tags keeps conversations matching these tags, sent comma-separated as Re:amaze's tag parameter.

factories.name: newGetConversationStep
factories.description: Read one conversation by its slug with its first message and a bounded list of its newest messages and internal notes.

inputSchema.description: GetConversationInput names one conversation and how many of its newest messages to return.

conversationId.description: ConversationID is the conversation's slug, such as knock-knock, as Conversation.ID reports it.

messageLimit.description: MessageLimit is 1 to MaxMessageLimit; zero uses DefaultMessageLimit.

factories.name: newCreateConversationStep
factories.description: Create one conversation on behalf of a customer in one channel. Re:amaze has no idempotency key, so the Step runs with sync durability, resends only after a confirmed 429, 503, or provably unsent request, and reconciles an unconfirmed attempt by finding the conversation whose data attribute holds the Step's key. A shared single-dispatch fence requires sync durability so retry attempts see its heartbeat checkpoint and do not resend a possibly accepted write.

ConversationRequesterInput.description: ConversationRequesterInput identifies the customer by email. Re:amaze uses the contact with that address or adds one named Name.

email.description: Email is one bare address such as jane@example.com.

name.description: Name names a contact Re:amaze adds; blank sends no name.

inputSchema.description: CreateConversationInput is one new conversation on behalf of a customer. Zero values leave a field to Re:amaze's defaults and the channel's automations.

assigneeEmail.description: AssigneeEmail assigns the staff user with this email, or blank for Re:amaze's routing.

channel.description: Channel is the slug of the channel to create the conversation in, Re:amaze's category, such as support. It is required; Settings > Channels lists each channel and its slug.

holdUntil.description: HoldUntil is when an On Hold (5) conversation's reminder fires, an RFC 3339 instant. It requires Status 5; blank sets no reminder time.

message.description: Message is the customer's first message, at most MaxTextBytes. It is required and sent unchanged as Re:amaze's message body.

requester.description: Requester is the customer the conversation is created for. It is required.

shouldSuppressNotifications.description: ShouldSuppressNotifications asks Re:amaze to send no email or integration notification for the first message, Re:amaze's message suppress_notifications.

status.description: Status is a Re:amaze status, or nil for Re:amaze's default.

subject.description: Subject is the conversation subject. It is required.

tags.description: Tags are set on the new conversation; channel automations may add more.

factories.name: newUpdateConversationStep
factories.description: Set the Re:amaze status or assignee of one conversation and add or remove tags; a repeated attempt finds the values already applied and writes nothing.

inputSchema.description: UpdateConversationInput is one change to an existing conversation. Nil and empty fields are left unchanged; this release cannot unassign a conversation.

addTags.description: AddTags adds tags and keeps the conversation's other tags. A tag already present in any letter case is kept as is.

assigneeEmail.description: AssigneeEmail assigns the staff user with this email, or blank to keep the assignee.

conversationId.description: ConversationID is the conversation's slug, such as knock-knock.

holdUntil.description: HoldUntil is when an On Hold (5) conversation's reminder fires, an RFC 3339 instant. It requires Status 5 and is always written, because Re:amaze does not return it to compare.

removeTags.description: RemoveTags removes tags in any letter case and keeps the conversation's other tags.

status.description: Status is the new Re:amaze status, or nil to keep it. Status 0 (Open) is a real value, so this field is a pointer.

factories.name: newReplyToConversationStep
factories.description: Add one public reply, which Re:amaze sends to the customer, or one internal note to a conversation. The message carries an origin_id derived from the Step, the Step runs with sync durability, and an unconfirmed attempt is reconciled by finding that origin_id instead of sending again. A shared single-dispatch fence requires sync durability so retry attempts see its heartbeat checkpoint and do not resend a possibly accepted write.

inputSchema.description: ReplyToConversationInput is one public reply or internal note on a conversation, attributed to the connection's staff user.

conversationId.description: ConversationID is the conversation's slug, such as knock-knock.

isInternalNote.description: IsInternalNote adds a note only staff see, Re:amaze visibility 1. False adds a public reply, visibility 0, which Re:amaze sends to the customer through the conversation's channel.

shouldSuppressAutoResolve.description: ShouldSuppressAutoResolve asks Re:amaze not to mark the conversation Done because a staff user wrote, Re:amaze's suppress_autoresolve.

shouldSuppressNotifications.description: ShouldSuppressNotifications asks Re:amaze to send no email or integration notification for the message, Re:amaze's suppress_notifications.

text.description: Text is the reply or note, at most MaxTextBytes. It is required and sent unchanged as Re:amaze's message body, which Re:amaze formats as Markdown.

factories.name: newFindContactByEmailStep
factories.description: Find the Re:amaze contacts whose email equals one address, from the first page of Re:amaze's name-or-email contact search; contacts belong to the account, not one brand.

inputSchema.description: FindContactByEmailInput names the email address to resolve.

email.description: Email is one bare address such as jane@example.com. It matches without regard to letter case.
